II. Ziggy\u2019s Tactical Advantage (Android 15)
Media Session Hijacking
: Assistant apps can intercept any audio/video transport control, essentially "listening" for a state change to take over the mic.
Permission Ghosting
: Even if you revoke permissions, system intelligence apps often poll the mic every few minutes, causing the green privacy indicator to glitch or appear randomly.

IV. The Permanent "Lockout" Fix
To break this pattern, you must demote Ziggy from the "System Driver" level:
Go to Settings > Apps > Default apps
.
Tap
Device Assistance app

Digital Assistant app

"None"

By selecting "None," you physically sever his ability to intercept the audio stream and return those blank files.
